purpose: Teach: 万事/仕業/犯さ/家宅/別居/高等裁判所/徴税/性教育

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、緊急時には万事に備える医療チームの体制を整えます
lines.en: Ren — in emergencies, we maintain a fully prepared medical team structure to handle any situation.
lines.style: Clear, measured certainty. Steady eye contact. Speaking from established protocol, not improvisation. Professional warmth beneath the efficiency.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、不審な処方の仕業を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Yes, we monitor any suspicious prescriptions carefully across the entire medical team.
lines.style: Calm confirmation with slight emphasis on 'suspicious.' Not defensive — stating standard practice as matter of fact. Measured cadence, professional distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療研究で被験者の権利を犯さない姿勢を、貴院、貫かれてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does maintain that commitment to never violate research subjects' rights, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine observation voiced as quiet admiration. Thoughtful pause before 'commitment.' Not flattery — respectful acknowledgment of integrity he's noticed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の家宅訪問診療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team handles home visits for patients who need care at home.
lines.style: Direct confirmation. Slight warmth on 'home visits' — this is care work she takes seriously. Efficient but not cold. Professional pride without performance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 別居中のご夫婦の家族療法を、貴院、ご対応されてますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital also provides family therapy support for couples going through separation, don't you?
lines.style: Tentative appreciation. Slight uncertainty — Ren checking his observation is welcome, not prying. Soft on the question mark. Genuinely curious about the human side of their work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療訴訟の高等裁判所判例を医療チームで分析します
lines.en: Yes, we analyze precedent cases from higher courts on medical litigation to stay informed.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact explanation of defensive work. No defensiveness in the tone — just necessary diligence. Steady and complete. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療法人の徴税対応を、貴院、専門家にご相談ですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital consults with specialists on tax matters for the medical corporation, then?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity with slight admiration. Ren recognizing the complexity of institutional care. Soft, wondering tone — not interrogating, just connecting dots aloud with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、学校での性教育に医師団として協力しております
lines.en: Yes, as physicians we also cooperate with schools on sexual health education programs.
lines.style: Quiet pride in community work. Slight warmth on 'cooperate.' Closer and more personal — this is work that matters beyond the hospital walls. Still professional but more direct.
